metadata.description: Public collection of Agent Skills for Claude Code, built spec-first with OpenSpec.

plugins.name: docs-generator
plugins.description: Structured Markdown to designed PDF and DOCX documents, plus a matching Excel template and Office theme.

plugins.name: azure-terraform-stacks
plugins.description: Terraform on Azure as independent stacks with one parameterized Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipeline, private AKS + PostgreSQL profile, Argo CD and a draw.io diagram, plus a read-only auditor subagent.

plugins.name: assessment-report
plugins.description: Technical assessment reports where every finding cites evidence a script has verified, unverified items are labelled and demoted by code, severity and roadmap follow fixed rules, and the executive document plus technical annex renders through docs-generator.
